scope: Refuse DXF LWPOLYLINE records that omit a required Y coordinate before publishing the entity; keep explicit zero Y, valid grouped coordinates, and manually authored objects working.
authority: Autodesk LWPOLYLINE DXF documentation specifies one group-10 X and one group-20 Y for each vertex: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-748FC305-F3F2-4F74-825A-61F04D757A50.htm. In contrast to widths and bulges, it does not describe group 20 as optional.
compatibility: Previously, libdxfrw accepted records with missing Y values and silently supplied 0. The current bundled LibreCAD parser likewise constructs default-zero vertices, and its 2D adapter cannot distinguish a missing Y from an authored zero. The stricter read therefore changes malformed-input compatibility deliberately; explicit zero values remain accepted, and no public class layout or callback changes. Counts alone do not establish pairing for every ambiguous reordered record.
change: At DXF record validation, if any vertex fields have been parsed, require the group-20 count to equal the masked group-10 count and the vertex vector size. Preserve existing declared group-90 checks and validation of complete grouped coordinates. Objects authored directly through the public API have no parser counters and remain unaffected.

validation.pre_fix: The focused test demonstrated that missing first, middle or last Y, grouped missing Y, and a missing Y without group 90 were all accepted and published in both ASCII and binary.
validation.post_fix: libdxfrw_lwpolyline_point_component_order passes both encodings: each malformed case refuses before the LWPOLYLINE callback, the same reader succeeds on a corrected source, explicit zero Y values remain valid, complete grouped records and manually authored sparse polylines remain valid, and adjacent sparse/copy/output-retry checks continue to pass.
validation.independent: Scratch inputs generated with ezdxf 1.4.5 low-level tag writers were checked with ezdxf's independent reader and a libdxfrw same-reader refusal/retry probe. Both readers reject the interleaved missing-Y source and accept the explicit-zero source in ASCII and binary. Complete grouped-array acceptance is a libdxfrw compatibility extension and is checked by the local regression, not asserted for ezdxf.
validation.tools: tools/audit_dxf_lwpolyline_missing_y.py authors and verifies scratch sources with ezdxf; tools/probe_dxf_lwpolyline_missing_y.cpp checks libdxfrw refusal and same-reader retry. No DXF fixture is committed.
